svg.title: F134.3 the agent bar: the interface design

g.text: F134.3 the agent bar: the interface design

text.tspan: The widget keeps its runner and gains a layout. In Bar it draws AgentBar, which holds the orb, the chips and the composer; the orb's state is a rule read from the runner.
